r: process(处理, 加工) + -ing(名词后缀) -> 处理
c: The data processing unit handles thousands of customer transactions every second during peak hours.
数据处理单元在高峰时段每秒处理数千笔客户交易。

r: pro-(向前) + cess(走) + -ion(名词后缀) -> 向前走的队伍 -> 队伍
c: The graduation procession marched slowly across the campus lawn as families watched proudly.
毕业典礼的队伍缓缓穿过校园草坪，家属们自豪地观看。

r: pro-(向前) + claim(叫喊, 来自拉丁语clamare) -> 向前大声喊 -> 表明、声明
c: The mayor stood on the steps of city hall to proclaim a new era of environmental sustainability.
市长站在市政厅台阶上宣告环境可持续发展新时代的到来。
